concerns.text: T015's deliverable `training_sample.parquet` cannot satisfy both the spec's independent test (columns `gradient_norms`, `quantized_logits`, `calculated_kl_divergence`) and the contracts (per-level `kl_div_int4/int8/fp8` + `quantization_level` per row, `timestamp`, `is_reasoning_task`, no `calculated_kl_divergence` field). The task is unexecutable as specified: an implementer cannot know which schema the parquet must conform to. Root cause is the spec/contract contradiction; tasks.md must pick one schema and state it explicitly in T015's verification.

T024 is a contract test for the report schema, but no task produces a `metrics.json` conforming to `metrics.schema.yaml` (T022A writes `test_metrics.json`, T027B writes `final_consistency_summary.json`, T030 writes `latency_metrics.json` in seconds vs the schema's ms). T024 has no producer to test against — it will fail or be vacuous. Either add a task that assembles a schema-conformant `metrics.json` or point T024 at the actual output files.

T021A says 'If a quantization level is missing from a split, PROCEED with available levels, log a warning' — this directly contradicts FR-004 (joint training across INT4/INT8/FP8) and T021B's own assertion 'training set contains samples from all available quantization levels'. The implementer cannot determine the correct failure behavior; specify FAIL LOUDLY or reconcile with FR-004.

requirements.txt omits `scipy` (required by T027 paired t-test/Shapiro-Wilk, T038 chi-square, T018/T019d VIF) and `onnxruntime` (plan's declared fallback engine). Tasks T027/T038/T018 are unexecutable in the isolated venv built from this file (Constitution Reproducibility Requirements).

T016 only logs the observed proportion of non-zero KL values, but US-001 Scenario 3 requires a statistical significance test (p < 0.05) comparing mean divergence across levels. No task performs this test; add the test to T016 or name the task that covers it.

T030 computes reduction from `total_time` (defaulting to 0 with a warning if missing) vs a baseline of summed sync times, but SC-002 targets ≥90% reduction in the *policy evaluation step*. The task measures a different quantity than its verification criterion; specify that `policy_evaluation_time` (recorded in T027's metrics) is the measured quantity, and remove the silent default-0 which makes the ≥90% check trivially pass/fail on missing data.

T031 offers an either/or deliverable ('GSM8K subset vs. held-out different-domain subset, or within-GSM8K difficulty distribution') without naming the held-out domain dataset or the difficulty-split criterion. Not deterministic — pick one option and name the data source.

T019 introduces PCA features and the data model specifies `feature_names: ["PCA1","PCA2"]`, but T042 perturbs raw gradient norms/curvature and T021B trains on unspecified features. State explicitly whether the KRR consumes raw features or PCA components so T021B, T042, and T027's feature extraction are mutually consistent.
